notes:
- Fit your printer: Suggest cuts only cuts the level that's too wide, and where the cut is solid, so you no longer get thin slivers or extra parts. An upright cut can go through the whole model or one level, and a part thinner than 20 mm is flagged.
- Shell pieces split to fit the printer: separate bits left by a cut through a curved wall are joined back onto the part beside them, so every part prints in one piece.
- A mold piece that used to come out in separate bits is fixed too: a small bit joins the piece next to it, a big one becomes a piece of its own.
